stemMd: A company packs 275 bottles into boxes holding at most 12 bottles. What is the minimum number of boxes needed?
explanationMd: Divide 275 by 12: 22 full boxes hold 264, leaving 11 bottles. They require one more box, so round the quotient upward to 23.

distractorRationale.a: This is capacity per box, not box count.
distractorRationale.e: This uses an unnecessarily high count.
